name: pii-guard
description: Masks personal data in prompts, stored conversation rows, and context before they reach the model, through a local pii-guard daemon (dictionary + rules). Fail-closed: when the daemon cannot be reached, prompts are dropped and rows are blanked.

daemonUrl.title: pii-guard daemon URL
daemonUrl.description: Local HTTP endpoint of the pii-guard daemon.

images.title: Images and documents
images.description: "drop" (default): image/document blocks are removed from stored rows because they cannot be masked. "pass": sent as they are.

bashSite.title: How to treat Bash output
bashSite.description: "data" (default): full rules. "code": dictionary + ids only, which keeps Edit old_string matching but misses phone/address patterns in command output.

safeTools.title: Tools whose output is already pseudonymized
safeTools.description: Comma-separated tool-name prefixes to leave untouched.
